caption: The drawing features a repeating geometric and floral pattern set against a deep reddish-brown background. The main shapes are large, stylized flowers with layered petals, primarily in light green, pale pink, and beige tones, arranged symmetrically across the surface. Branch-like cream or beige lines connect smaller, similarly shaped floral forms distributed throughout the composition. The background itself is filled with small, regular diamond motifs, each containing a subtle linear design in beige, creating a sense of texture and depth behind the larger floral and branch elements. The entire arrangement is bordered by a plain margin in off-white, framing the patterned area. The artwork uses a limited color palette, predominantly reds, pinks, beige, light green, and white, with thin vertical lines overlaying much of the pattern, giving the surface a textured, woven appearance.
title: Ingrain Carpet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
